messages:
Tomas (Billing Ops): LumaMed (CUST-12900) dispute: INV-2026-0702 includes a duplicate promo line (APR_HEALTH_50 applied twice) for $300 and a one-time onboarding fee of $750 that was supposed to be waived per signed SOW. Customer asks for full correction and refund. Ticket: https://support.redwood/t/12233
finance-bot: Billing alert created: BT-2026-678 (possible promo stacking + erroneous onboarding fee).
Riya (Revenue Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines so we can confirm? Also we need to know if customer requested account credit or refund to card.
Tomas (Billing Ops): Invoice excerpt:
``
Line 1: Promo - APR_HEALTH_50 - Applied - $-300
Line 2: Promo - APR_HEALTH_50 - Applied - $-300
Line 3: One-time - Onboarding Fee - Applied - $750
Line 4: Usage - tokens - 120,000 - $450
``
Customer says SOW Appendix B waives onboarding fee. They want refund to card for the $750 and account credit for the duplicate promo $300 (so they can see it on next bill). Total correction $1,050.
Sophie (Billing): Accounting preference: refund if customer paid by card and asked for reversal of a one-time charge; promo reversals are usually credit memos so there's a clean audit trail. Suggested split: CM-2026-1401 for -$300 (GL 6302), and REF-2026-412 for $750 to card (GL 6350). I'll draft ledger entries and queue for posting if finance approves.
Maya (CS): Customer explicitly requested refund for the onboarding charge because their AP needs reversal; account credit is acceptable for promo. They provided SOW link: https://contracts.redwood/sow/CUST-12900.pdf and confirmed card on file should be used for refund.
Priya (CFO): Approve the proposed split: $300 credit memo (GL 6302) and $750 refund to card (GL 6350). Please include memos: "Duplicate promo reversal - INV-2026-0702" and "Onboarding fee waived per SOW - INV-2026-0702". Note policy: refunds > $500 require CFO sign-off (this is borderline but approved). Sophie, proceed and attach audit refs.
finance-bot: Approval ticked by CFO Priya. Generating tasks: CM-2026-1401, REF-2026-412.
Sophie (Billing): Posted CM-2026-1401 (GL 6302) and initiated REF-2026-412 to card on file (GL 6350). Draft ledger entries:
```
Date: 2026-07-09
Account: 6302 - Customer Credits
Customer: CUST-12900 (LumaMed)
Amount: -300.00
Memo: Duplicate promo reversal - INV-2026-0702
Reference: CM-2026-1401

Date: 2026-07-09
Account: 6350 - Customer Refunds
Customer: CUST-12900 (LumaMed)
Amount: -750.00
Memo: Onboarding fee waived per SOW - INV-2026-0702
Reference: REF-2026-412 / CM-2026-1402
```
Audit links: https://audit.redwood/cm/CM-2026-1401 and https://audit.redwood/ref/REF-2026-412. Refund ETA 3-4 business days.
Riya (Revenue Ops): I'll open ENG ticket ENG-5419 to prevent promo stacking for APR_HEALTH_50 and add a pre-bill rule that blocks applying onboarding fees when a signed SOW flag exists. Also will add a promo QA check to our billing pipeline.
Maya (CS): Notified customer with copy: "We've issued a $750 refund to your card and applied a $300 account credit for duplicate promo on INV-2026-0702. Refund should appear in 3-4 business days. Sorry for the confusion and thanks for the SOW link." Customer replied :thumbsup:.
Tomas (Billing Ops): All billing actions complete from our side. Marking BT-2026-678 closed.
finance-bot: Tasks closed: BT-2026-678. ENG-5419 created.
Priya (CFO): Thanks team. Please ensure we capture this in the monthly revenue recognition notes for July and include references to CM/REF numbers.
Tomas (Billing Ops): Will include in the reconciliation and send a copy of the journal entries to accounting. Thread resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
